messages:
Nora: Heads up — client 'QuantSure' POC failing. Rerank returns 400 with 'embedding_dim_mismatch' and sometimes 429s when uploading candidate batches. Can eng jump in?
Sam: Copy. Which encoder/model are they using?
Nora: They sent snippet: encoder returns 768 floats but they point rerank at redwood-embed-512. Batch_size set to 50.
Ivy: That explains mismatch. Quick fixes: ask them to switch encoder to 512 or re-encode. Alternatively we can offer a temporary projection shim (768->512) but it's lossy.
Luis: 429s likely due to large payloads + high concurrency. Recommend drop batch_size to 8-16 and add exponential backoff. I'll pull their tenant metrics.
Nora: Error payload: {"error":"embedding_dim_mismatch","message":"expected 512 got 768"}
Sam: Can we improve error clarity while they fix this?
Ivy: Yes — add header X-Expected-Embedding-Dim and include suggestion text. Also log dim_mismatch event. Low risk change.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: rerank-dim-header v1.0.2 to staging — initiated by @Ivy — ETA 8m
Luis: I'll scope a short security note: embeddings stored in tenant space; temporary projection is ephemeral and not persisted.
Nora: I'll send client steps: stop sending 768 vectors to 512 model, reduce batch size, enable backoff, consider re-encoding hot docs first.
Sam: We'll also prepare a cost estimate for re-encoding ~2.5M docs and propose a discounted batch slot for the POC.
Ivy: Internal follow-up: add short doc to DevEx about common embed dim mismatches.
Nora: Thanks team — looping customer in now.
